question: In berkshire_13f_q4_2024_holdings.csv, aggregate shares and valueUSD by nameOfIssuer (summing all rows). Among issuers whose total shares exceed 50 million, which issuer has the highest implied value per share (total valueUSD / total shares)? Give the issuer name exactly as in the file.
solve_py:
import os, pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
a=pd.read_csv(D+'/berkshire_13f_q4_2024_holdings.csv');g=a.groupby('nameOfIssuer')[['shares','valueUSD']].sum();g=g[g.shares>50e6];print((g.valueUSD/g.shares).idxmax())
